termsModal.title: TentaKlik Affiliate Terms & Conditions
termsModal.intro1: The TentaKlik Affiliate Program gives you the opportunity to earn commissions by recommending TentaKlik ad account rental services to prospective users.
termsModal.intro2: By joining the TentaKlik Affiliate Program, you declare that you have read and agreed to the following terms:
termsModal.section1Item1: Can only use 1 referral code from an Affiliate Partner.
termsModal.section1Item2: Must have a registered and verified TentaKlik account.
termsModal.section1Item3: Must use the service for legitimate businesses/products and comply with TentaKlik Client Policies.
termsModal.section2Item1: Must have a registered TentaKlik account that has passed the activation process.
termsModal.section2Item2: Self-referrals, spam, bots, brand abuse, or unauthorized promotional activities are prohibited.
termsModal.section2Item3: Commission disbursement may be suspended if there are arrears or policy violations.
termsModal.section3Item1: 20% commission from the ad account rental fee on the Affiliate Member's first transaction.
termsModal.section3Item2: Commission does not apply to renewals.
termsModal.section3Item4: Disbursements are made every month, between the 5th and 10th.
termsModal.section4Item1: Refunds, cancellations, or violations of the Client Policy may result in a clawback/deduction of commissions.
termsModal.section4Item2: Tax obligations on commissions are the responsibility of the Affiliate Partner.
termsModal.closing: By clicking "I Agree & Continue", you agree to the TentaKlik Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions.
